turns.text: Hey Lloyd, I finally wrapped up the backend refactoring for the Todo HTTP API workflow. OpenAPI documentation generation was implemented as part of the Todo HTTP API workflow.
That's great progress! Having auto-generated docs is a huge time saver for the team.
Yeah, it was tedious setting up the schema definitions, but worth it. By the way, did you see the rain forecast for tomorrow?
Yes, it looks like heavy showers are expected throughout the day. I'd recommend carrying an umbrella.
Noted. Also, I need to order a new mechanical keyboard. The old one is getting sticky.
I can help you look for options if you want. What switch type do you prefer?
Maybe Brown switches. Let me know if you find anything good under $100.
Will do. I'll send over some options shortly.
Lloyd, I've been digging into the new model updates. Qwen 3.6plus thinking traces were analyzed.
Interesting. Did you find any notable patterns in the reasoning steps?
Some inconsistencies, but mostly it's quite stable. Anyway, I'm starving. What's for dinner tonight?
I was thinking pasta with basil pesto. Is that okay with you?
Perfect. Do we have pine nuts left?
I believe there's a half-full jar in the pantry. I'll double-check.
Great. Also, the bug in the login form is still there. I'll fix it tomorrow.
Sounds like a plan. Let me know if you need help debugging.
